shape_notes: Built from primary sources 2026-08-29; per-key section citations in _field_sources.
ss_wage_base is null and unresolved: the SSA table returned HTTP 403 and the figure was not carried from memory.
mortgage_acquisition_debt_cap uses the 2026 debt-date selector idiom, not the legacy 2024 pre/post scalars.
SECURE 2.0 60-63 catch-up and Roth catch-up do NOT apply to TY2023; OBBBA applies to none of it.
Legacy bonus_depreciation_pct scalar; do not consume as the post-2024 bonus_depreciation object.
CORRECTED 2026-08-29: section_179_cap/phaseout previously held the 2023 figures; now $1,220,000/$3,050,000 per Rev. Proc. 2023-34 §3.25. suv_cap and excess_business_loss_threshold added.
Legacy pre/post mortgage scalars replaced by the debt-date selector; safe-harbor threshold split into non_mfs/mfs.
student_loan_interest, adoption_credit, kiddie, FEIE, FSA and fringe keys added 2026-08-29 from Rev. Proc. 2023-34.
OBBBA changes require target-form and effective-date verification.
obbba_deductions ADDED 2026-08-29 - they were missing although the tips/overtime/senior/car-loan deductions apply for TY2025-2028 and TY2025 returns are live.
section_179_cap/phaseout reflect OBBBA (PL 119-21), which OVERRIDES Rev. Proc. 2024-40's $1,250,000/$3,130,000.
Legacy mortgage scalars replaced by the debt-date selector; safe-harbor threshold split.
Mileage is interval-selected; legacy annual mileage scalars are intentionally null.
Bonus depreciation is acquisition-date selected, not a single annual percentage.
safe_harbor_high_agi_threshold is split into safe_harbor_high_agi_threshold_non_mfs and safe_harbor_high_agi_threshold_mfs; never reuse the 2024/2025 scalar for MFS.
Mortgage acquisition-debt caps use an explicit 2017-12-15 debt-date selector and transition exception; do not select the cap by calendar year.
excess_business_loss_threshold is lower than TY2025 because OBBBA re-based it — that is expected, not a defect.
adoption_credit_max renamed to the adoption_credit object so the shape matches 2023-2025; kiddie and student_loan_interest added.
